_comment: Raptor's egg library (library/README.md). Written for Raptor.
name: Beszel
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: Beszel is a lightweight server monitoring hub with history, Docker stats and alerts. Runs the hub, creating the admin account from its settings at the first start, or on your first visit when they're empty.
startup: unset APP_URL USER_EMAIL USER_PASSWORD; [ -z "{{BESZEL_APP_URL}}" ] || export APP_URL="{{BESZEL_APP_URL}}"; if [ -n "{{ADMIN_EMAIL}}" ] && [ -n "{{ADMIN_PASSWORD}}" ]; then export USER_EMAIL="{{ADMIN_EMAIL}}" USER_PASSWORD="{{ADMIN_PASSWORD}}"; fi; export CHECK_UPDATES={{CHECK_UPDATES}}; exec ./beszel serve --http 0.0.0.0:{{SERVER_PORT}}

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Beszel: downloads the Beszel hub from its GitHub releases, checked
# against GitHub's SHA-256. The data folder (beszel_data: users, systems,
# history) is never touched.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server
work=/mnt/server/.raptor-build
rm -rf "$work" && mkdir -p "$work"
trap 'rm -rf "$work"' EXIT
fail() { echo "$1"; exit 1; }

case "$(uname -m)" in
    x86_64) arch=amd64 ;;
    aarch64) arch=arm64 ;;
    *) fail "Beszel has no build for this CPU ($(uname -m))." ;;
esac

want="${VERSION:-latest}"
[ "$want" = latest ] || want="v${want#v}"
tag=$(gh-release tag henrygd/beszel "$want") || fail "Set Version to latest, or to a release such as 0.21.2, then reinstall."

if [ -x beszel ] && [ "$(cat .beszel-version 2>/dev/null)" = "$tag" ]; then
    echo "Beszel $tag is already installed."
else
    echo "Downloading Beszel $tag"
    gh-release download henrygd/beszel "$tag" "beszel_linux_${arch}.tar.gz" "$work/beszel.tar.gz"
    tar -xzf "$work/beszel.tar.gz" -C "$work" beszel
    install -m 0755 "$work/beszel" beszel.new
    mv -f beszel.new beszel
    echo "$tag" > .beszel-version
fi
mkdir -p beszel_data
echo "Installed Beszel $tag."

variables.name: Version
variables.description: The Beszel version to install, such as 0.21.2, or latest. Reinstall to change it.

variables.name: Address
variables.description: The hub's full public address, starting with http or https, used in links in emails and alerts. Leave it empty to use the server's address.

variables.name: Admin email
variables.description: The admin account's email, created on the first start with Admin password. Leave both empty to create it on the first visit to the hub.

variables.name: Admin password
variables.description: The admin account's password (at least 8 characters), used only when the hub has no users yet.

variables.name: Check for updates
variables.description: Ask GitHub for new Beszel releases and show a notice when there is one.
